reason: I run everything in Telegram and a notebook and it works. A new CRM with no customers I can call is a risk, and $25 is real money for me. I would maybe click the free trial, but I would not pay.

would_change_my_mind: A shop owner in Uzbekistan I can phone who uses it daily, plus a Lean price under about $15 after a trial where my own Telegram chats really work.
